newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Indonesian democracy leader calls on Australia.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian democracy leader calls on Australia.

text.p: Indonesian opposition figurehead Megawati Sukarnoputri on Saturday called on Australia to back her democracy push, two days before Australian Prime Minister John Howard was due to arrive in Jakarta.
"I hope that the Australian government and people will support democracy in Indonesia," Megawati told Australia's Seven Network television.

Australia enjoys close relations with the government of Indonesian President Suharto and has shown little sympathy for Megawati, who was ousted as leader of the Indonesian Democratic Party in June by a government-backed faction.
Australian Foreign Affairs Minister Alexander Downer ignored calls from her Australian supporters to meet her during his visit to Jakarta in July.
Howard will visit Indonesia this week, his first trip to Jakarta since winning office in March.
The television network issued an English transcript of Megawati's statement, which she made in Bahasa Indonesia.
